mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order (order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_order SET status = #{status}, payment_time = #{paymentTime}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_order SET status = #{status}, ship_time = #{shipTime}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_order SET status = #{status}, delivery_time = #{deliveryTime}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_order SET status = #{status}, cancel_time = #{cancelTime}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_order WHERE status = 'CREATED' AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE)
